newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June commodity futures volume up 9.6% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June commodity futures volume up 9.6% yr/yr.

text.p: Trading volume at Japan's nine commodity futures exchanges totalled 5,913,243 lots in June, up by 9.6 percent from the same month a year ago but down by 16.8 from May, an industry group said on Tuesday.
Turnover in June was lifted by strong gains in precious metals futures, led by platinum group metals (PGM), the figures from the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges showed.

"Volatile prices of platinum group metals, caused by the expected resumption of Russian PGM exports to Japan, fuelled active selling from private investors, especially in palladium futures," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
